safety.dont1: WAT leit jam ia ki jingkieng ba dap um, ki mori ba dheng, ne ki surok lum ba la khang.
safety.dont2: Kieng ban shong ha ki kamra plymeng kiba don harud ki lum ba kham thyrnia haba jur slap.
